catalogue.name: The Dvergi Freeholds
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: No Friends But The Mountains
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Rapid Entrenchment: One (1) friendly unit has Cover(1) until it moves.
● Illum Mission: place flare token anywhere within LOS of a friendly unit. Units within 6” of the flare loses concealment, hidden and camouflage, and has inaccurate. Remove token at the end of next turn.
● ADM1 Prep-fire: before start of game, place 5” diameter circle od dangerous terrain anywhere on table. Roll at end of activation for each wound caused that activation, remove on 6+.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Morale(1, entire force)
sharedRules.description: All models gains ability Morale(1): Unit removes level extra (own) action markers in endphase, as long as all models in unit has at least this level of Morale.

sharedRules.name: Sandbags
sharedRules.description: Unit has an extra Defence(6) wound.

sharedRules.name: Logistics
sharedRules.description: +1 FP, use only on FP powers

sharedRules.name: Artillery Support
sharedRules.description: 3x Fire Mission (fire with any spotter, else indirect)

sharedRules.name: Dvergi Triage Center
sharedRules.description: For every three (3) casualties suffered place one (1) Dvergi Freeholder in staging. In the endphase you may reinforce Freeholder squads that have taken casualties with Freeholder models in staging (up to original strength, place in cohesion, further than 2” from enemy models). You may also form units of 6-12 models.
